description: China's NBS 70-city residential price indexes — new-build commercial housing (新建商品住宅) and resale/existing housing (二手住宅), year-on-year and month-on-month, for Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and 67 other NBS-tracked cities. Pass `city` (English name, e.g. "Beijing") for that city's history (up to 24 months); pass `month` ("YYYY-MM") to pin a specific release; pass neither for the latest month's full 70-city cross-section. Index values use the prior period = 100 convention (e.g. 97.7 = a 2.3% year-on-year fall). Answers "Beijing home price index", "which Chinese cities have falling house prices", "China 70-city house price index for August". Keyless, sourced live from the National Bureau of Statistics of China, via Eastmoney's data centre.

city.description: One of the 70 NBS-tracked cities, by English name (e.g. "Shanghai", "Chengdu"). Omit for all 70 cities in the latest month.

month.description: A specific release month as "YYYY-MM" (e.g. "2026-08"). Omit for the latest available month.
